name: local GPU / imagegen live smoke

gpu.model: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

runtime.name: vllm-omni
runtime.config: docker run -d --name metrum-live-imagegen --gpus device=0 --ipc=host -p 8000:8000 -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface vllm/vllm-omni:v0.30.0 vllm serve Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo --omni --port 8000

notes: vllm-omni 0.30.0 Z-Image-Turbo via /v1/images/generations; requests send num_inference_steps=9 guidance_scale=0.0 size=1024x1024 per the model card (server default is 50 steps; researched 2026-10-02)
